DeviceSettings.AudioBitrate_Description: Audio bitrate requested from the server (unit: bps) e.g., 128000 (128kbps)
DeviceSettings.AudioCodec_Description: Audio codec requested from the server
DeviceSettings.AudioDup_Description: Request the server to route audio to the device speaker while capturing
DeviceSettings.AudioEncoderName_Description: Specific audio encoder name requested from the server; if set, ignores AudioCodec
DeviceSettings.AudioSource_Description: Request the audio source. “output” means device playback audio, and “mic” means microphone
DeviceSettings.CameraSettings_Hint: Effective when video source is camera
DeviceSettings.CodecOptions_Description: Set advanced key-value options for audio/video encoders in the format: “key:type=value,key2:type=value...”
DeviceSettings.EnableAudio_Description: Request the server to send an audio stream. Requires Android 11+. Audio is not captured when off
DeviceSettings.EnableControl_Description: Request the server to listen and process control events (e.g., clicks, keystrokes). View-only mode when off
DeviceSettings.EnableVideo_Description: Request the server to send a video stream. No picture is displayed when off
DeviceSettings.FlexDisplay_Description: Automatically sync the virtual display size when the window is resized
DeviceSettings.HidKeyboard_Description: Use virtual HID keyboard device for input (Requires Android 12+)
DeviceSettings.HidMouse_Description: Use virtual HID mouse device for input (Requires Android 12+)
DeviceSettings.InvalidBitRate: Please enter a valid bitrate, e.g., 8000000
DeviceSettings.InvalidCameraFps: Please enter a valid camera framerate, e.g., 30
DeviceSettings.InvalidCameraSize: Please enter a valid camera resolution, e.g., 1920x1080
DeviceSettings.InvalidFps: Please enter a valid framerate, e.g., 60 or 59.94
DeviceSettings.InvalidResolution: Please enter a valid resolution (long edge), e.g., 1920
DeviceSettings.InvalidScreenOffTimeout: Please enter a valid screen-off timeout, e.g., -1 or 30000
DeviceSettings.MaxFps_Description: Max frame rate requested for server encoding
DeviceSettings.MaxSize_Description: Max resolution, scales the longest side without affecting aspect ratio
DeviceSettings.PowerOffOnClose_Description: Request the server to turn off the screen when the client disconnects
DeviceSettings.PowerOn_Description: Request the server to wake and turn on the screen upon startup
DeviceSettings.ScreenOffTimeout_Description: Delay (ms) before turning off the device screen if there is no client interaction; -1 to disable
DeviceSettings.ShowTouches_Description: Request the server to enable 'Show touches' in developer options
DeviceSettings.StayAwake_Description: Request the server to hold a Wakelock to prevent the device from sleeping during connection
DeviceSettings.VideoBitrate_Description: Video bitrate requested from the server (unit: bps) e.g., 8000000 (8Mbps)
DeviceSettings.VideoCodec_Description: Video codec requested from the server
DeviceSettings.VideoEncoderName_Description: Specific video encoder name requested from the server; if set, ignores VideoCodec
DeviceSettings.VideoSource_Description: Request the video source. “display” means screen content, and “camera” means camera

ServerSettings.DirectHostList_Desc: One IP address per line. These will be published as host candidates during screencasting
ServerSettings.EnableHostCandidateOverride_Desc: Publish specified public direct-connect addresses for all clients, suitable for traditional deployments without STUN/TURN
ServerSettings.EnablePortMapping_Desc: Suitable for FRP or port-forwarding scenarios. Uses a fixed local UDP port and allows a separate published ICE port
ServerSettings.EnableWebRtcOverride_Desc: Applies only to the current server and current account, and takes priority over global default settings during screencasting
ServerSettings.ExternalPublishPort_Desc: Leave empty to match the local bind port. If mapped through FRP, you can enter the external access port
ServerSettings.GlobalIceTransportPolicy_Desc: "all" prefers direct connection, while "relay" forces TURN relay
ServerSettings.GlobalResetDefault_Desc: Restore the global default WebRTC configuration to system defaults
ServerSettings.IceTransportPolicy_Desc: Local preferred policy used when screencasting for the current server
ServerSettings.LocalBindPort_Desc: The fixed UDP port actually listened on by the server. FRP on the internal side should forward to this port
ServerSettings.ResetDefault_Desc: Restore the local WebRTC preference for the current server to its default value
